name: league-throughput
note: The worked example for scripts/sweep.mjs, and the manifest Session 04 of the learn set took its throughput bar on. Three arms of the shipped league configuration that differ in nothing: that is not an experiment, it is the measurement of how much the runner buys, and it is also the check that the runner is deterministic -- three arms sharing a seed and a start must write the same first iteration. A real sweep gives each arm one different flag and leaves everything else in common, which is the set's third frozen choice. No start is named here because tournaments/ is gitignored and a worked example that cannot run on a fresh clone is not one; pass --from to give every arm the same checkpoint, or leave it and they all start from the seed.
